name: dev-workflow
description: Spec-to-ship workflow for FE, BE or full-stack projects on top of superpowers: spec → plan + test plan → TDD → UI testing with Chrome DevTools MCP saved as Playwright tests → race-condition & load testing → report, pull request and an acceptance test guide for BA/QA, with review gates, a 3-round bug feedback loop, a quick mode for small fixes, status tracking and an optional live dashboard.
